{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
data_clean = data[(data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute raw conversion rates by channel
conversion_rates = data_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute raw difference (email - paid_search)
diff_raw = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Print the raw conversion rates and difference with 4 decimal places for clarity
print(f"Conversion rate for email: {conversion_rates['email']:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate for paid_search: {conversion_rates['paid_search']:.4f}")
print(f"Raw difference (email - paid_search): {diff_raw:.4f}")

# Return the raw difference
diff_raw"}
